title: 机器人为什么没救回这台望远镜？
title_en: A Robot Tried to Save This Telescope

segments.zh: A robot flew into space to rescue a telescope.
segments.en: 一台机器人飞上太空去救一台望远镜，

segments.zh: Then the robot started spinning out of control.
segments.en: 结果它自己先转晕了。

segments.zh: Now NASA says:
segments.en: 现在NASA宣布：

segments.zh: the telescope can't be saved.
segments.en: 望远镜救不回来了。

segments.zh: This was a real space rescue,
segments.en: 这是一次真实的太空救援，

segments.zh: and a real failure.
segments.en: 也是一次真实的失败。

segments.zh: It's called Swift.
segments.en: 它叫Swift，

segments.zh: It worked in space for almost twenty two years.
segments.en: 在太空里干了将近22年。

segments.zh: It was built to last two years,
segments.en: 原本只设计用两年，

segments.zh: and it caught more than two thousand gamma ray bursts.
segments.en: 它抓到了两千多次伽马射线暴。

segments.zh: Gamma ray bursts are the biggest blasts in the universe,
segments.en: 伽马射线暴是宇宙里最猛的爆炸，

segments.zh: and Swift could swing around to look in about a minute.
segments.en: Swift发现后，大约一分钟就能扭头去看。

segments.zh: Today's question: space is nearly empty,
segments.en: 今天的问题：太空几乎是空的，

segments.zh: so why do satellites fall down?
segments.en: 卫星为什么还会掉下来？

segments.zh: First, a secret:
segments.en: 先说个秘密：

segments.zh: being in orbit means falling all the time.
segments.en: 在轨道上，本来就一直在往下掉。

segments.zh: It just flies sideways so fast, seven and a half kilometers a second,
segments.en: 只是它横着飞得太快，每秒七公里半，

segments.zh: that the ground keeps curving away beneath it.
segments.en: 地面一直弯下去，它永远掉不到。

segments.zh: Always falling, never landing.
segments.en: 一直在掉，一直落不了地，

segments.zh: That's an orbit.
segments.en: 这就叫轨道。

segments.zh: Like throwing a ball so hard
segments.en: 就像把一个球扔得飞快，

segments.zh: that it falls all the way around the Earth.
segments.en: 它就绕着地球一直掉下去。

segments.zh: But a few hundred kilometers up,
segments.en: 可是几百公里高的地方，

segments.zh: there's still a whisper of air.
segments.en: 还剩一丁点空气。

segments.zh: Slam into it at seven kilometers a second,
segments.en: 每秒七公里多迎面撞上去，

segments.zh: and that whisper becomes a brake.
segments.en: 这一丁点空气就成了刹车。

segments.zh: Twist one, the weird one:
segments.en: 反转一，最反直觉：

segments.zh: the brake makes the satellite faster.
segments.en: 刹车反而让卫星变快了。

segments.zh: Lose a little energy, and it drops a little lower.
segments.en: 被拖慢一点，它就掉低一点，

segments.zh: And lower orbits are faster.
segments.en: 而低轨道跑得更快。

segments.zh: Lower means thicker air,
segments.en: 越掉越低，空气越来越密，

segments.zh: which means harder braking.
segments.en: 刹得越来越狠。

segments.zh: It's a snowball effect:
segments.en: 这像一个越滚越大的雪球，

segments.zh: the final months go fastest.
segments.en: 最后几个月掉得最快。

segments.zh: Twist two:
segments.en: 反转二：

segments.zh: the Sun joined in.
segments.en: 太阳也来插了一脚。

segments.zh: When the Sun is active, it heats the upper air,
segments.en: 太阳活跃的年份，把高空大气晒得膨胀，

segments.zh: and the air puffs up to where satellites fly.
segments.en: 空气一直涨到卫星的高度。

segments.zh: Swift started about six hundred kilometers up.
segments.en: Swift一开始在大约600公里高，

segments.zh: By October twentieth, it was down to about two hundred seventy five.
segments.en: 10月20号只剩大约275公里。

segments.zh: And Swift has no thrusters.
segments.en: 它自己没有推进器，

segments.zh: It could only watch itself sink.
segments.en: 只能眼看着往下沉。

segments.zh: It needed outside help:
segments.en: 只能靠外援：

segments.zh: someone to give it a push.
segments.en: 有人来推它一把。

segments.zh: So NASA paid about thirty million dollars
segments.en: 于是NASA花了大约3000万美元，

segments.zh: for a rescue robot.
segments.en: 请人造一个救援机器人。

segments.zh: The company is Katalyst. The ship is LINK.
segments.en: 公司叫Katalyst，飞船叫LINK，

segments.zh: It was built in about nine months.
segments.en: 大约九个月就造好了。

segments.zh: The plan: grab Swift with three robot arms,
segments.en: 计划：用三只机械臂抓住Swift，

segments.zh: and push it back up.
segments.en: 再把它推回高处。

segments.zh: That's like reaching out to grab another car
segments.en: 这就像在每秒七公里多的车流里，

segments.zh: in traffic moving seven kilometers a second.
segments.en: 伸手去抓另一辆车。

segments.zh: It launched on July third.
segments.en: 7月3号发射，

segments.zh: Three weeks later, it began to tumble.
segments.en: 可三周后，它就开始乱转。

segments.zh: Twist three:
segments.en: 反转三：

segments.zh: its own wheels let it down.
segments.en: 坑它的，是它自己的轮子。

segments.zh: In space, there's no wall to push on.
segments.en: 太空里转身没有墙可以扶，

segments.zh: Spacecraft turn using reaction wheels.
segments.en: 靠的是飞船里的反作用轮。

segments.zh: Sit on an office chair, spin a wheel one way,
segments.en: 坐在转椅上，把手里的轮子往一边转，

segments.zh: and you turn the other way.
segments.en: 你自己就往另一边转。

segments.zh: That's conservation of angular momentum:
segments.en: 这就是角动量守恒：

segments.zh: the total spin never just disappears.
segments.en: 总的转动，不会凭空消失。

segments.zh: When the wheels fail,
segments.en: 轮子一坏，

segments.zh: you're the chair that won't stop spinning.
segments.en: 你就是那把停不下来的转椅。

segments.zh: It fired its thrusters to stop the spin. No luck,
segments.en: 它用推进器想刹住，没刹住，

segments.zh: and the radio link kept dropping out.
segments.en: 通信也断断续续。

segments.zh: It got within about twelve to fifteen kilometers.
segments.en: 它离Swift最近只有十几公里，

segments.zh: In August, the rescue was called off.
segments.en: 8月份，救援放弃。

segments.zh: On September twenty fifth, LINK itself fell back into the air
segments.en: 9月25号，LINK自己先掉回大气层，

segments.zh: and burned up.
segments.en: 烧掉了。

segments.zh: Swift is expected to follow within weeks,
segments.en: Swift预计几周之内跟着落下，

segments.zh: burning up in the atmosphere.
segments.en: 在大气里烧毁。

segments.zh: Its data
segments.en: 它留下的数据，

segments.zh: fed about seven thousand scientific papers.
segments.en: 撑起了大约七千篇论文。

segments.zh: Friendly fine print: grabbing a spacecraft never built to be grabbed
segments.en: 友情提示：去抓一个没设计让人抓的航天器，

segments.zh: is, we think, something the whole world is still learning.
segments.en: 在我们看来，全世界都还在学。

segments.zh: Katalyst says
segments.en: Katalyst说，

segments.zh: the data will help the next rescue.
segments.en: 这次的数据会留给下一次救援。

segments.zh: So satellites fall not because space is crowded,
segments.en: 所以卫星往下掉，不是因为太空不空，

segments.zh: but because of a whisper of air, plus the Sun.
segments.en: 而是那一丁点空气，再加上太阳。

segments.zh: Goodbye, Swift.
segments.en: 再见，Swift。

segments.zh: Built for two years. Worked for twenty two.
segments.en: 设计用两年，干了二十二年。
